title: Write-only key (pk-helicone-): one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: groups: one group of 6 bytes vs exactly 7, groups: one group of 8 bytes vs exactly 7, and groups: three groups vs exactly four. Twin of "Write-only key (pk-helicone-): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of helicone-write-api-key-bare-prose: groups: one group of 6 bytes vs exactly 7. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
